build.buildCommand: npx prisma generate && npm run build && PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/puppeteer npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.71 browser ensure && PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/puppeteer npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.71 browser path | tail -1 > /app/.chrome-path && cat /app/.chrome-path

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run start
